ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the $8\times 8$ grid shown in the figure, where the side length of each small square is $1$, and points $A$, $B$, $C$, and $D$ are all on the grid points. If $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at point $E$, what is the value of the tangent of $\angle AED$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, select the lattice point K, and draw lines AK and BK.\\
Observing the figure, it is clear that $AK \perp BK$, $BK=2AK$, and $BK \parallel CD$,\\
$\therefore \angle AED=\angle ABK$,\\
$\therefore \tan \angle AED=\tan \angle ABK= \frac{AK}{BK}=\boxed{\frac{1}{2}}$
